dialogues.original: Good evening! Trick or treat! I vant to suck your... candy!

choices.answer: A vampire! And a polite one too!
Nice accent! Very dramatic!
You almost said something else there...

dialogues.original: Thank you! I've been practicing my Transylvanian accent!

choices.answer: It's very good! Where'd you learn it?
Impressive! Ready for your treat?

dialogues.original: I know! My drama teacher says I should be an actor!

choices.answer: You'd be great at it! What plays have you done?
I can see that! Here's some candy!

dialogues.original: No! I said candy! Vampires only want candy on Halloween!

choices.answer: That's what they all say...
Fair enough! Here you go!

dialogues.original: From... movies! Lots of vampire movies!

choices.answer: Which one's your favorite?
Good source! Here's your candy!

dialogues.original: Yes! I've been trick-or-treating for hours! My feet hurt!

choices.answer: You should take a break! Want some water?
Almost done! Here's your treat!

dialogues.original: Oh, uh... underwater ones! I mean... THE UNDERGROUND ones! Like... in caves!

choices.answer: Underwater? That's a weird mistake...
Caves make sense for vampires! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: You can trust me! I promise! Cross my heart!

choices.answer: Vampires don't have heartbeats though...
Good enough for me! Here you go!

dialogues.original: Dracula! The one with all the water... I mean BATS! The bats!

choices.answer: Water? There's no water in Dracula...
Classic choice! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: Water? Oh yes! I get very thirsty! Vampires get thirsty!

choices.answer: For water... or something else?
Sure! Let me get you some!

dialogues.original: I was just thinking about... swimming! I love swimming!

choices.answer: Vampires don't usually love water...
Swimming's great! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: It's just an expression! I definitely have a heartbeat! Listen! *thumps chest*

choices.answer: That sounded... wet? Are you okay?
Okay! I believe you! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: Uh... the castle is near water! A moat! With water! That's what I meant!

choices.answer: That's quite a stretch, but okay...
Sure! Nice save! Here you go!

dialogues.original: For... drinking! Yes! Regular drinking! Like... a regular kid!

choices.answer: Why do you keep mentioning water?
Hydration is important! Here's candy too!

dialogues.original: Wait! I can explain! Let me just adjust my mask... NO WAIT!

choices.answer: Too late! What are you hiding?
Keep it on! Here's your candy!

dialogues.original: Well... THIS vampire does! I'm a... modern vampire! We've evolved!

choices.answer: Evolved to breathe underwater maybe?
Modern vampires! Interesting! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: Wet? No! Must be the humidity! Very humid tonight!

choices.answer: It's not humid at all tonight...
If you say so! Here's your candy!

dialogues.original: Yeah! Exactly! The moat! Full of... fish! I mean... MIST! Spooky mist!

choices.answer: FISH?! Are you some kind of sea creature?!
You really like water themes, huh? Here's candy.

dialogues.original: Because I'm... very health conscious! Hydration is important!

choices.answer: For a vampire? Suspicious!
True! Good for you! Here's candy!

dialogues.original: NO! I mean... maybe! Science is complicated! Can I just have candy?!

choices.answer: You're definitely not a vampire! But here's candy anyway.
Nice try, fish monster!

dialogues.original: Uh... different people feel temperature differently! Can I please have my candy now?

choices.answer: Fine! You're weird, but here!
No! You're clearly not human!
